result: Amanda Martinot was omitted from the original author list of 23 authors and has been added to the corrected author list of 24 authors. Her affiliation is the Department of Infectious Disease and Global Health at Tufts University, and she contributed to formal analysis, methodology, validation, visualization, and histopathology. All authors agreed to this correction.
evaluation: Claims C1-C4, C8-C10 provide consistent and verifiable information about the authorship correction. The original list (C10) had 23 authors, the new list (C9) has 24 authors, and the difference is Amanda Martinot's addition (C8). Her affiliation (C1), contributions (C2), competing interests (C3), and author consent (C4) are all explicitly documented.
